# Preprint full text

`article.xml` is the unmodified JATS response for Kerr SM and colleagues, “Clinical case study meets population cohort: Identification of a BRCA1 pathogenic founder variant in Orcadians”, medRxiv (2022), https://doi.org/10.1101/2022.07.18.22276644, version 1.

Source: https://www.medrxiv.org/content/early/2022/07/22/2022.07.18.22276644.source.xml Captured 2026-10-19. SHA-256: `2aaae406756a79eefd742ac7d9eadb2e21c1e5a6287f585407a18d466cdbb207`. The article's embedded permissions grant CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Copyright 2022, posted by Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory. No changes were made to the captured XML.

All API replies in the test are authored controls. The details control retains only the DOI, version, server, license and advertised JATS URL from the official API response. The Europe PMC control retains the preprint identifier and DOI. The six PMID records are synthetic controls, not captured clinical evidence. Failure responses are authored controls, not provider observations.
